name: grokbuild-grokbots
description: Let Grok Build (or Cursor) wake a Grok Bot or send it a prompt through the bot's own webhook-triggered routine. One grokbots MCP server with a roster, confirm-gated sends and an optional read-only mode, plus setup skills. Each installer uses their own routine URL and key.

GROKBOTS_WEBHOOK_URL.title: Default bot webhook URL
GROKBOTS_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. POST URL of YOUR Grok Bot's webhook-triggered routine (copy it from the routine panel; placeholder example https://example.com/webhook). https only. Leave blank if you use GROKBOTS_ROSTER_FILE only.

GROKBOTS_WEBHOOK_KEY.title: Default bot webhook key
GROKBOTS_WEBHOOK_KEY.description: Optional. The routine's sender key, sent as Authorization: Bearer and X-Automation-Key. Your own key; never commit or paste it in chat.

GROKBOTS_DEFAULT_BOT.title: Default bot name
GROKBOTS_DEFAULT_BOT.description: Optional. Roster name for the env-configured bot (lowercase, e.g. example-agent). Default: default.

GROKBOTS_ROSTER_FILE.title: Roster file
GROKBOTS_ROSTER_FILE.description: Optional. Absolute path to a JSON roster of several bots ({"bots":[{"name","url" or "urlEnv","keyEnv" or "keyFile"}]}). Keys are never stored inline.

GROKBOTS_SENDER.title: Sender label
GROKBOTS_SENDER.description: Optional. Short label sent as "from" in each POST so the bot knows who woke it. Default: grokbuild.

GROKBOTS_READ_ONLY.title: Read-only mode
GROKBOTS_READ_ONLY.description: Optional. Set to 1 (or true/yes/on) to hide wake_bot and send_prompt. Unset, empty, 0, false, no or off = all tools. Any other value also turns read-only ON (fails closed, with a warning).

GROKBOTS_BRIDGE_URL.title: Reply bridge URL
GROKBOTS_BRIDGE_URL.description: Optional. Base URL of YOUR grok-bot-universal-bridge with the GrokBuild adapter (placeholder example https://bridge.example.com). When set with GROKBOTS_BRIDGE_KEY, send_prompt asks it for a one-time reply route and wait_reply reads the bot's reply. https only (plain http only to loopback).

GROKBOTS_BRIDGE_KEY.title: Reply bridge client key
GROKBOTS_BRIDGE_KEY.description: Optional. Your client token for that bridge's GrokBuild adapter, sent only as Authorization: Bearer to the bridge. Never put in a prompt or payload; never commit or paste it in chat.

GROKBOTS_WAIT_SEC.title: Reply check-in interval (seconds)
GROKBOTS_WAIT_SEC.description: Optional. How long one wait_reply / wait:true call waits before returning "awaiting_reply" so the host agent can post progress and call again (default 45, 5-600). A check-in interval, not a time limit.

GROKBOTS_WAIT_MAX_SEC.title: untilReply budget (seconds)
GROKBOTS_WAIT_MAX_SEC.description: Optional. How long one untilReply call may keep waiting while the host receives progress notifications (default 300, 30-3600).
